_description: Per-contract placeholder → default-value maps for the EMPLOYMENT bucket. Convention: PROVIDER_* slots hold the EMPLOYER (Company) details; CUSTOMER_* slots hold the EMPLOYEE (individual). Compensation slots are EMPLOYMENT-specific: EMPLOYEE_BASE_SALARY (annual base), EMPLOYEE_TARGET_BONUS_PCT (numeric percent of base, e.g. '40' for 40% target bonus), EMPLOYEE_INITIAL_EQUITY (initial equity grant value at signing). TERM_YEARS represents the agreement's initial fixed term where applicable; for at-will agreements with no specific term length, set 'suppress_initial_term': true in the metadata so the brief doesn't print a misleading 'Initial term:' line.
